name: Neoplastic grid
summary: A plane divided by black horizontal and vertical bars into white fields and a few fields of primary colour.
how: Use only horizontal and vertical lines; no curves and no diagonals.
Fill one to three fields with red, yellow or blue; leave the rest white or grey.
Set the bars at one weight, 1% to 2% of the short side.

origin.note: Theo van Doesburg starts the magazine De Stijl; Piet Mondrian publishes his ideas on the new plastic in painting there.

adoptions.via: Gerrit Rietveld builds the Schröder House in Utrecht from planes and bars in white, grey and primary colours.
Web pages split the screen with black rules into white and primary-colour fields.

sources.title: Hans L. C. Jaffé, De Stijl 1917-1931 (1956)
